Welcome to the new era of Call of Duty®:.

Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II drops players into an unprecedented global conflict that features the return of the iconic Operators of Task Force 141.

Infinity Ward brings fans state-of-the-art gameplay, with all-new  gun handling, advanced AI system, a new Gunsmith and a suite of other gameplay and graphical innovations that elevate the franchise to new heights.

Modern Warfare® II launches with a globe-trotting single-player campaign,  immersive Multiplayer combat, and a narrative-driven, co-op Special Ops experience. 

You also get access to Call of Duty®: Warzone™, the all-new Battle Royale experience.

Campaign: Experience dynamic moment-to-moment gameplay that includes a variety of play spaces with blockbuster set pieces and action-packed moments, high-stakes heists, and cloak-and-dagger spy activity.

Multiplayer: players will test their skills across 16 new maps at launch, including 12 core 6v6 maps and 4 Strike maps that can be played 2v2 or 6v6. 

Zombies: Black Ops 6 marks the epic return of Round-Based Zombies, the fan-favorite mode where players will take down hordes of the undead in two brand-new maps at launch.

We use the information we collect to operate Activision Services; 
Perform the services, and personalizing your experience on our Properties
Commercial purposes, such as facilitating purchases of Activision products or service, or sending newsletters, marketing, surveys, and to provide you with targeted advertising

Interact with Customer Service

Undertaking activities to verify and maintain the quality of our service, such as preventing cheating and bad behavior

Activision will hold your personal information until termination of service.

hash_d2ecbae39a3a1c3: Weren't nothin' Civil 'bout the War that cursed this town and dragged it to Hell. Drop in for a spell - where nights never end and folks are dyin' to meat you.
hash_398c9731b47a3b35: A new world, a new enemy, and some strangely familiar allies. Uncover the secrets of the Dark Aether's most dangerous corner and face the primordial power of its ancient guardian.

hash_3a91e43ca99704ca: Yeah, but how do the other creatures, gods and demons fit in? Y'know, the ones Requiem encountered when the Dark Aether started spilling into our world?
hash_3a95633ca99a126e: And all of ‘em out to chow down on our home.

hash_3a98e93ca99d2bf7: “Never again”, huh? That mean next time some power crazed nut-bar washes up here, you’ll put ‘em down?
hash_3a98e73ca99d2891: And leave us small folk to pick up the pieces.

hash_1e3ea9316ea3c406: Ugh! I sense another headache coming on.
hash_1e3b25316ea0ade3: Is there truly no one in charge? No Shogun? No Daimyo? This is anarchy!

hash_565531797a5e36a0: Both are true. We are ancient. As ancient as the Dark Aether itself.
hash_565532797a5e3853: Before, there was nothing. Then we were. And when we are gone, there will be nothing once more.
hash_565536797a5e3f1f: Some were created deliberately, pieced together from the memories of mortals consumed by the Dark Aether.

hash_5658bb797a6156f5: It is usually the mortals who come dreaming of power. Of domination.

hash_5658b5797a614cc3: However, sometimes the creations of the Dark Aether do inherit its hunger, its need to consume, to assimilate new memories from which to create anew.
hash_5658b7797a615029: The urge to control... To bring order to chaos... Again, this is a mortal proclivity.
hash_5658b6797a614e76: Sometimes one comes, attempts to organize - but such things are fleeting. Sand castles on the shore.
hash_5658c0797a615f74: You are both military men, I can feel how alien this is for you. Your desire to lead and follow, is deeply ingrained.
hash_564e47797a583d54: But we are the guardians of creation, not the masters of it.
hash_564e49797a5840ba: This has been humbling for us, Carver... Should reality survive, I am certain we will take steps.

zm_sat_intel/avalon_city_document_1_text:
"Together, we won't fear tomorrow. The Guild is hope. A cause for unification as we band together to fight for a better world. The catalyst for change is in my hands, and the Guild will be with us every step of the way."

- Emma Kagan
zm_sat_intel/avalon_city_document_2_text:
Eric Samuels. Enlisted in the army in 2010. Served in President Bosworth's security detail. Part of Specter One.

Attentive and detail-oriented — compulsively so. Prefers "old school," out of date, tactics.

Possible exploits: Fear of not living up to his responsibilities. Imposter syndrome.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_city_document_3_text:
My best friend died today.

It happened so fast, I didn't even see it. One second he was there, the next his face caved in. But the two of us were alone... there was blood on my hands.

I think I tried to help him. To stop the bleeding. I'm sure I tried to stop the bleeding.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_city_document_4_text:
"Transcript: Day One of the November Trials. Patient A inhaled the gas, and died instantly. His blood pressure, pulse, everything was normal. But the moment the gas was released, within his first breath, his vitals were off the charts. He screamed and that was it. We need a new subject."

- Dr. Gideon Falkner
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q1_document_1_text:
Avalon has evoked Marshall Law. For your safety, Guild soldiers will be stationed throughout Avalon, as will Guild tech, including our state of the art robotics.

Equipped to not only respond to citizens in crisis, Guild soldiers and tech alike are trained to keep foreign elements at bay, should the need arise.

We thank you for your cooperation during these difficult times.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q1_document_2_text:
At first all I saw was gas — red and rapidly expanding.

Now all I see are spiders. They're on my clothes. They're in my hair. Under my skin. I tried to claw them out but I couldn't get them all.

The doctors had to amputate.

But I can still see them.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q1_document_3_text:
"Transcript: Day Thirty of the November Trials. Patient X was exposed to a new formulation of gas. His vitals spiked, he screamed, and then, he lived. Then he ripped the throat out of a lab technician. Collateral damage, as Emma would say. But his violence is promising. It's manipulation. Control. Emma will be pleased."

- Dr. Gideon Falkner
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q1_document_4_text:
"Dumas crafted a foundation I know I can build on. I know she would want me to continue the life-changing innovations the Guild pioneered. And I know she'd want me to put that technology to good use. The world can be a scary place, but the Guild is here to keep us safe, from each other, and from ourselves."

- Emma Kagan
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q2_document_1_text:
There are soldiers everywhere in Avalon — they're supposed to be here for aid but, it doesn't feel like they're helping us.

There's gas in the air. No one seems to know what it is, so I'm trying not to breathe it in.

Aid centers just opened, I may go there.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q2_document_2_text:
Leilani Tupuola. Joined the Navy, and then NZSAS before catching the attention of Specter One. A soldier with a terminal illness — highly probable it takes care of her before we do. Known for her "heart of gold," she'll be easy to manipulate.

Possible exploits: Lack of confidence in augmentations. Trauma from her combat incident in 2033.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q2_document_3_text:
"I don't need you to understand, I need you to execute. If you're against my vision, you're against progress. What can any whistleblower say the public doesn't already know? The world is sick. We're dying. You know what's worse than starting a war? Losing one. What some people have yet to understand, is that I'm ensuring we never lose again."

- Emma Kagan
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q2_document_4_text:
What happened in Avalon is a tragedy.

While the Guild works to find and bring justice to those responsible, we'll be opening humanitarian aid centers across Avalon.

If you or your loved ones require assistance, medical attention, or even a safe place to stay, please, let the Guild take care of you.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q3_document_1_text:
Command Centers include automated drones, turrets, and bots. Avalon is on full lockdown for its own protection, with the Black Ops team our priority target.

If those JSOC assholes approach a command center, or otherwise, you are authorized to kill on site.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q3_document_2_text:
David Mason.

Joined the US Navy in 2000.

Current Rank: Commander.

Leads a counterterrorism unit.

Brash tactics. Emotional. "Daddy issues."

Possible exploits: Frank Woods. Menendez.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q3_document_3_text:
TO: REDACTED

You say "reconstructing Menendez from his 2025 version, the current 2035 model is a 99.9% match." But in the latest version his eye color looks off. Cross reference other photos or adjust the lighting and send it back. His last voice pass was closer — run the processing once more and send me the transcripts the model was trained on."

- Emma Kagan
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q3_document_4_text:
"Transcript: Day Seven of the November Trials. Patient J. We lessened the dosage of the gas. He lived longer this time, but screamed for his mother. It is likely he was hallucinating — seeing his mother jump from a rooftop. He died shortly after, but if we could capture that fear, bottle it, we have something."

- Dr. Gideon Falkner
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q4_document_1_text:
"Transcript: Day Zero of the November Trials. We've learned so much since the trials in the 90's, conducted by the CIA. Exposure is no longer about the impact of the toxin, but controlling it. Inhalation will be marked as the primary mode of delivery. Experimentation begins tomorrow. Results to follow."

- Dr. Gideon Falkner
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q4_document_2_text:
Lost my mom today — held her hand through plastic after she jumped off a third story building. It looked like there was gas in the air when she jumped. It had a red tinge.

The Guild said her death was a suicide, but I think it was something else.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q4_document_3_text:
Mike Harper. Joined the Navy in 2005.

Rose to SEAL Team 6, and then Specter One. Failed retiree aiming to subvert expectations around his age and ability.

The Guild will prove old dogs can't learn new tricks.

Possible exploits: Trust issues. Overzealous ego.
zm_sat_intel/avalon_q4_document_4_text:
"The Guild began in Avalon's criminal underworld amid crime factions and power struggles, until Sevati Dumas changed everything. In the 90's, she helped the Guild take out the competition and seize control of Avalon. The Guild played by her rules now, and she aimed to use them to do some real good in the world. I hope to honor and continue Sev's legacy."

- Emma Kagan

5-25-54

I can’t put up with Dean’s insane whims anymore! I’m leaving tonight and if that’s the end of my career - so be it.

I’d rather be “the has-been Evelyn Sharpe” than an obituary in the newspaper.

This cabin is a prison, there’s no way in hell I’m going to let it be my tomb. I’ll sneak out before 
dawn, get to the main road, and hitch my way back to town.

Whatever happens, it’s safer than staying here with him.
hash_53b5d45c18422cc4:
?/?/1968

Maintaining this facility has begun to feel like a fool’s errand. Monsters attack us day and night. The survivors look to me - they cling to hope. I WILL NOT let them sense my fear. The root of our suffering is that rocket - I am convinced. The sooner we are rid of it the better.
hash_2436893eeb905a31:
January 27, 1865

The northern aggressors are day’s march away but Daddy still insists that we will be safe. He and the other men ignore the signs. Folks are shuttering their windows and barring the doors, convinced they will weather the advancing enemy by simply choosing to ignore it.

Nothing is being done to prepare for the battle to come.

Their arrogance will be the death of Ashwood.

This place… We cannot experience it as it is… Our brains constrained… Linear… Our lives’ dictated by our universe’s fickle time’s arrow… But not here… Its past, future and present are melange, constant, recurring… Stirred by reverberations of events that ring through the weft and warp of the Aether itself… There is one echo… Unfathomably vast… Ushering cataclysm, but trailing a veritable Cambrian explosion of creation in its wake… What could have caused such a tsunami in the skein of reality?

…have to wait. In all my dreamings in this place of dark wonder, none have captured my imaginings as do those of the dwellings that cower under the malevolent glow of that demon cloud. Surely no such place was ever in the material, no it was pulled from the imaginings of the void, I am sure of it.
